name: Look up member name and share balances
description: Given a full member number, signs in to the CoreServ 7.2.14 back-office console, performs a Member Lookup, and returns the member's name along with the current savings and checking share balances from the Member Summary screen. Outputs: memberName (string, member's full name as shown in the "Name" label — treated as PII/sensitive), savingsBalance (currency, Balance column of the "Primary Savings" savings share row), checkingBalance (currency, Balance column of the "Everyday Checking" checking share row).

usage.whenToUse: Use when an agent or operator needs a quick, read-only balance and identity check for a specific credit-union member and already knows the exact member number — e.g. answering a member's balance inquiry, verifying funds before a follow-up task, or confirming the account holder's name before servicing.
usage.notFor: Not for searching by name, SSN, phone or partial member number (the lookup requires the full member number). Not for loan balances, transaction history, or sub-account/card servicing, and not for any action that modifies the member record — this capability only reads the Member Summary screen. Note: it returns the single savings and single checking share shown on the summary; members with multiple shares of the same type may need a broader read.

params.name: memberNumber
params.description: The member's full account/member number as it appears in CoreServ, e.g. "10001". Partial numbers are not accepted by the lookup.

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Full name of the member on the Member Summary header block.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's savings share (S01 Primary Savings) in the Shares table.

outputs.name: checkingBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's checking share (S05 Everyday Checking) in the Shares table.
